x: Gerry avenged Tony Fairclough by giving Shergold of Portsmouth a 64 second lead and a beating! Belgrave were back in front again, by a mere 2 seconds and our hopes rested on Pat newell giving our last man something to play with on the last lap.

Geoff North making a very welcome return to form took the first leg of 5½ miles and with a grand effort brought us home in 3rd place only 9 secs. behind the leader Ingleton of Ryde A.C. and barely yards behind Shergold of Portsmouth.
